subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and if so through what supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the implementation direction depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus an API or plugin/adapter boundary, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring Open WebUI-specific mirroring to live behind a plugin or integration boundary, adding only any missing generic core seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat/session-management and Open WebUI proof history make this the best available routing owner for the product and storage-boundary decision.
